slides.what_it_does: Two mana 1/1. Every artifact creature you control gets +1/+1. Drawn too late? Pay WB and discard it to deal 2 damage to a creature and gain 2 life.
slides.best_home: Any artifact creature deck. Thopters, Servos, Myr, Borg tokens — all of them get bigger.
slides.take: A lord when you need a lord and a removal spell when you don't. That's rare on a two-drop.

cards.name: Command Subadjunct
cards.take: One mana 2/1. Every artifact creature you control gets vigilance.

cards.name: Primary Unimatrix Adjunct
cards.take: Four mana, and all your artifact creatures have double strike. With Locutus out that gets silly.

cards.name: Conquest Mission
cards.take: Three mana. Every nontoken artifact that enters makes a 1/1 Borg. At six quest counters it makes two.

slides.question: Would you build the Borg artifact deck, or is it too linear?
